tuples.subject: penal_charges
tuples.special_circumstance: penal charges for individual borrowers for purposes other than business must not be higher than penal charges for non-individual borrowers for similar non-compliance of material terms and conditions
tuples.quote: (v) The penal charges in case of loans sanctioned to ‘individual borrowers, for purposes other than business’, shall not be higher than the penal charges applicable to non- individual borrowers for similar non-compliance of material terms and conditions.
